fusions.name: Barbed Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaff the Wrapped
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A barbed jab deals 20 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled Across
fusions.desc: Hauls you 5 tiles forward along a line. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Snagged Vein
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
